title: A second live voice: Gemini 3.8 Live. Agent settings per character. Reset to defaults.
description: Talk to your avatar on Gemini 3.8 Live or Extended Thinking as well as GPT-Live-1, give each character her own reasoning and action engine, and put any Settings page back to its defaults with two clicks.
highlights: Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live · Extended Thinking as a second live voice system (Settings › Live Voice System). Your reasoning and action engines (OpenAI, xAI, Codex App Server, OpenClaw, Hermes, Grok Build, EnConvo) work with it exactly as with GPT-Live-1. Avatar Show and the group conversation still use GPT-Live-1.

The voice belongs to the character: Settings › Character and right-click › Character › her name › Voice list the voices of the system in use, with gender beside each one. “Try voices…” opens a small window that stays open: play a voice as often as you like, then Use.

Agent settings per character. Settings › Reasoning and Actions are the defaults for everyone; any character can have her own reasoning, actions on or off, action engine, permission and engine agent under right-click › Character › her name › Agent, or in Settings › Agents. In Avatar Show and Together each performer uses her own.

“Reset to defaults” in the header of every Settings page: two clicks, that page only, and it never touches your API keys or sign-ins. New installs start on Delegate · OpenAI · GPT-5.6 Luna for harder questions, with the same key GPT-Live-1 uses.

Fixes found by asking every voice system and every engine to really create and delete a file: a request transcribed in two pieces no longer cancels its own task; she no longer claims to have done something with Actions off; engine checks work from any Settings page (“Unavailable outside the app”); the Actions page and the right-click menu say which engine really does the work.
